decisions.briefing: Stocks dipped slightly today, with both the NASDAQ and S&P 500 down about 0.4%, which counts as a quiet, neutral day rather than a real sell-off. We have only $446 in cash, which is below the $500 minimum for a new buy, so we are holding all 7 positions and saving our cash. DPC and IBP passed every momentum check today, so they are first in line when a strong up day gives us a reason to buy.

market_education.summary_en: Both the NASDAQ and S&P 500 fell about 0.4% today, a small and evenly spread decline that looks like routine day-to-day movement rather than a reaction to one big event. No news headlines were included in today's data, so we can't name a specific cause, and it would be misleading to guess at one. Underneath the flat headline numbers, many individual stocks still showed buying interest: names like DPC, IBP and HUBS had price gains backed by unusually heavy trading volume.
market_education.summary_zh: 納斯達克與標普500指數今日同步下跌約0.4%，跌幅溫和且分佈平均，屬於日常的正常波動，並非由單一重大消息引發的拋售。由於今日數據未附帶新聞標題，我們無法指出具體成因，貿然臆測反而容易誤導判斷。值得留意的是，指數表面持平，但個股層面仍見買盤承接，DPC、IBP及HUBS等股份錄得放量上漲。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder is cash an investor deliberately keeps on hand instead of investing right away, so it's ready when a better opportunity comes along. On a quiet, slightly down day with only a small amount of cash, it often makes more sense to wait than to force a trade just to be fully invested. When a strong up day arrives, that saved cash can go into the best-looking stocks.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指投資者刻意保留、暫不投入市場的現金，以便在更理想的時機出手。在大市窄幅偏軟、手頭現金不多的日子，與其為了「滿倉」而勉強入市，不如耐心觀望。待市場出現明確的強勢上升訊號，便可將這筆資金投入評分最高的股份。
